evidence.actual: MA 7
DIFFERENTIAL CALCULUS

actual.t: Differential Calculus introduces functions, limits, continuity, derivatives and applications of differentiation to introductory engineering problems. Students analyze changing quantities, compute and interpret derivatives, model related rates, examine curves and construct optimization models with stated assumptions. Worked examples and problem-solving activities support mathematical reasoning, interpretation and clear communication. This is a deliberately misaligned test draft: its CLO statements and EGA mappings are intentionally inappropriate, so they must be reviewed rather than used for instruction. The prerequisite cell is blank in the supplied curriculum image; this draft does not assert an official prerequisite of None.
